b2-34-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Clearing the Cellar
b2-34-01.scenario: In the harbour tavern, Fülig Jimmy asks what you will do at the weekend with the pile of useless old things in the cellar.
b2-34-01.prompt: Tell Jimmy what you will do with the old things at the weekend.
cues: Say when you will do it
Say what happens to the old things
b2-34-01.target: Hétvégén kidobjuk a pincéből a felesleges limlomot.
b2-34-01.english: At the weekend we will throw the unnecessary junk out of the cellar.
b2-34-01.canDo: I can recognize and use twin-words like limlom and hercehurca in speech and writing

b2-34-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Angry at All
b2-34-02.scenario: Piszkos Fred asks whether you are angry with Fülig Jimmy after the trouble in the harbour.
b2-34-02.prompt: Tell Fred you are not angry, and give a reason.
b2-34-02.target: Dehogyis haragszom rá, elvégre a barátom.
b2-34-02.english: Not at all am I angry with him, after all he is my friend.
b2-34-02.canDo: I can wave away an exaggeration with ugyan már and deny something firmly with dehogyis

b2-34-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Boss and the Bill
b2-34-03.scenario: Fülig Jimmy asks what happened when the boss saw the bill, and who took the job on.
b2-34-03.prompt: Tell Jimmy how the boss reacted and what you did about the job.
cues: Say what you did about the job
b2-34-03.target: A főnök kiakadt, de én bevállaltam a feladatot.
b2-34-03.english: The boss freaked out, but I took on the job.
b2-34-03.canDo: I can recognize common slang verbs with metaphorical preverbs, such as bevállal, kiakad and rákattan

b2-34-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Letter to the Harbour Office
b2-34-04.scenario: Piszkos Fred wants to tell the harbour office in a formal letter that the job fell through because of a colleague's neglect, and asks how to say it.
b2-34-04.prompt: Tell Fred how to put it formally in the letter.
b2-34-04.target: A projekt a munkatárs mulasztása következtében meghiúsult.
b2-34-04.english: The project failed as a result of the colleague's neglect.
b2-34-04.canDo: I can replace a slang word with its formal equivalent

b2-34-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Staying Calm
b2-34-05.scenario: In the harbour tavern, Fülig Jimmy asks how you keep calm when the harbour police are after you.
b2-34-05.prompt: Tell Jimmy what helps you endure hard moments.
cues: Say what it helps you do
b2-34-05.target: Az egészséges önirónia segít elviselni a nehéz pillanatokat.
b2-34-05.english: Healthy self-irony helps endure hard moments.
b2-34-05.canDo: I can recognize puns and self-irony in conversational Hungarian

b2-34-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Ways of Writing
b2-34-consolidation.scenario: Piszkos Fred asks which style you use in a letter to the harbour office and which with your friends.
b2-34-consolidation.prompt: Tell Fred which style you use in each case.
cues: Say what you use in the official letter
Say what you use with friends
b2-34-consolidation.target: A hivatalos levélben hivatalos stílust használunk, a barátainkkal pedig köznyelvi szavakat.
b2-34-consolidation.english: In an official letter we use an official style, and with our friends colloquial words.
b2-34-consolidation.canDo: I can tell slang, colloquial and formal words apart
